topics.title: Mathcounts Tips (1.75K Posts)
topics.text:
I made State this year and gave my spot to someone else because my math life is over. I'd just like to list out some tips that people may need for MATHCOUNTS.

1. If you don't have any idea how to start a problem, skip it. i.e. you have no idea what the first step is.

2. Find an order that is good for you. Good mathletes tend to prefer the last ten, first ten and then the middle ten.

3.. Study Geometry.above all. Geometry becomes a crucial part in mathcounts and they include many different kinds of problems. tbh, most number theory and algebra problems are the same. Define a variable and solve for the variable.

4. Lastly, make sure you read AoPS Volume One. It will help you to better understand theorems and other stuff you may need.



I hope this helps. Please add more to the list if you can.



Thank you.

IMAGE
